gap: No result ChatGPT got states how much physical screen area each extender adds. Area is what sets how many chart panes fit when text is kept at the same size. The 16-inch 1920×1200 pairs (FOPO S11 and S9G, 230 sq in added) show about 29% more chart area than the Trio 3 Pro (179 sq in). The Trio's extra pixels go into denser text (187 PPI against 141.5), not into more room.
standout_why: I compared against the pages ChatGPT got. itechguides 2026 (15 best) lists sizes, resolutions and some weights but no area, PPI or per-product derived figure. deskgearhq lists the Trio 3 Pro as 'QHD 1400p' and the ZenScreen Duo as 1920×1200, with no area, PPI or weights. Macworld's best-for-Mac list (cited) gives the Trio a 4.13 lb weight and a resolution that contradicts itself (1920×1080 in the spec line, 'High QHD' in the pros), with no area or density. Xebec's comparison page (cited) has no specs at all. Our own best-laptop-screen-extender page already states added megapixels (Trio 6.27 MP, S7 4.61 MP, S788 6.91 MP), so pixel count is not new. Physical area and pixel density are new. No page mentions day trading as a use, though itechguides mentions 'trading dashboards' once for the Trio.
decides: This undercuts ChatGPT's reason for its pick. Both chats chose the Trio 3 Pro because its resolution gives 'more room for multiple chart panels.' On 14.1-inch panels, 2240×1400 is 187 PPI, so at the same scaling its text is about 76% the size shown on a 16-inch 1920×1200 panel. At equal text size, the Trio adds the same area as the FOPO S7 (179 vs 176 sq in). It adds 16% less than the FOPO S10 (208 sq in) and 29% less than the FOPO S11 or S9G (230 sq in). For a trader who sits at a desk and wants the most chart and Level 2 area at a readable size, the driver-free FOPO S11 wins on this figure, as long as the laptop has a video-capable USB-C port for each screen. The S9G ties it on area, but its video path is a mix of USB-C and HDMI. The Trio 3 Pro still wins for people who want the sharpest text and a lighter, smaller bag. It is the 14-inch-class pick, and it needs two DP Alt Mode USB-C ports to run with no driver (Macworld). The FOPO S788 adds the most area (345 sq in across three screens), but FOPO says it needs its UsbDisplay driver, and ChatGPT itself warned against driver-based screens for time-sensitive trading.

findings.label: Method: added area and pixel density
findings.value: area per screen = d² × w·h/(w²+h²); 16:10 → 0.4494·d², 16:9 → 0.4273·d²; PPI = √(px_w² + px_h²) / d
findings.note: Plain geometry using each maker's diagonal, aspect ratio and resolution. At equal physical text size, the number of chart panes that fit scales with physical area, not pixel count. The source URL is the Trio input page; the formula itself is not sourced from it.
